decision_scope: APPROVE_ONLY_THE_BINDING_STRATEGY; DO_NOT_BIND_KE_OR_ANY_COMPONENT_TO_L03_OR_CYCLE1, FILL_L03_EXACT_SURFACE_FIELDS, CREATE_A_SURFACE_CANDIDATE, AUTHOR_OR_VALIDATE_OPI, UNLOCK_QA, CHANGE_STR003_STR005, OR ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

governance_decisions.statement: Every Grammar Core component requires explicit reviewed binding per construction/lesson; materialization is not binding.
KE remains CANDIDATE and its possible L03 use must be a separate binding proposal, not automatic inheritance.
AN/EN remain a separate unresolved subject/person lane and are not consumed by the interrogative binding strategy.
KU/KUVAN remain separate content-interrogative components with closed-list/no-arbitrary-generation boundaries.
No OPI/QA/STR003-STR005/runtime action and no parent-lexeme/HNK3000 work is authorized by this gate.
If approved, open only a separate L03 KE binding proposal gate and stop; do not reuse the same approval for binding or surface selection.
